visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Sticky instead of fixed
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The bar is fixed, so it covers the content under it and the content has a padding to make room. Use sticky, which keeps the bar in the page flow. It must stay at the top while scrolling.
visualizerParams.initialCode: Content

solution.code: Content
solution.explanation: A fixed bar is taken out of the page, so you must reserve room for it by hand. A sticky bar stays in the flow, takes its own space and sticks only when needed.

checks.label: The bar stays at the top while scrolling
